messages.subject: NGINX with SSL issue.
parts:
Hello,

I found a similar question "Proxy Shiny?" on this forum, but did not see a solution for my situation.
Everything works fine when using http, but after I set up a SSL reverse proxy with NGINX - the server.R files
stopped working - I don't see anything happening. I see only output from ui.R, no errors, but no results from server.R either.
It looks like there's no communication between client a server.

Please help. Thanks

messages.author: 15629754714d0272
messages.subject: Re: NGINX with SSL issue.
parts: Turns out the root cause of the problem was not easy to understand as it worked fine on iPad but not on other systems. So, after I found out that there was a new software version Shine Server 0.4.0.0 out there, I have made a move for an upgrade and also I have upgraded the 'shiny' package to shiny_0.8.0.99. After everything was done based on the instructions from this resource:http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/ - the issue has gone. Thanks.
